text: My best mate's a werewolf.
So am I.
And he's just let himself in.
Last week, I found out he took his uncle's arm. And told me I did it.
He didn't come at me. He sat down.
He said, it's a full moon in an hour.
And Mick's not here to watch us.
Then he slid something across the table.
A silver nail.
Mick put one in every windowsill on this street, he said. Go and look.
Number two. Silver.
Number four. Silver.
Even Danny's house. Silver.
His mum was at the window. Watching me count.
Every house on Moor End.
Except one.
Mick's.
Eight little holes in the wood. Fresh. Still splintered.
Danny hadn't come to warn me.
He'd come to pull them out.
Come out.
